I have translated this article and recommended it to many of my friends.

This article is really beautiful, I especially like the "I wasn't looking to survive, I was looking to live." and "It's not just the skyline itself that was beautiful to me, but it had the added weight of everything that had happened to me in the preceeding years."

An idea comes to my mind, since different artists have different personalities, maybe one day we will have an artist who uses his or her art to help people?

item.title: A Song of Hope and Home
item.content:encoded:
This started out as the song written by Frederick von Hayek that Adebowale talks about towards the end. I didn't think that concept had any true soul, so I made this instead.

Also: while this an AWCY GoI-Format, I don't see Adebowale as a true member of AWCY. Rather, they are an independent anartist who displays pieces at the dicennial conventions run by AWCY, which tend to be a bit more mainstream than pure AWCY.

EDIT: I forgot that the AWCY conventions are dicennial, not annual. This got bumped back to 1994 from 1998 to make it fit.

If you liked this thing and would like to read some comments about it, or check out other things I've written, head to my author page for more!
